content: Ibn Turka's residence in Yazd, ca. 825-29/1422-26, spanned relatively uneventful and productive years in which he produced many lettrist works (R. Anjām, R. Suʾl al-Mulūk, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat, R. Nuqṭa, R. al-Inzāliyya, R. Muḥammadiyya, Sharḥ al-Basmala) and revised and expanded his lettrist summa, the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ, in the company of Sharaf al-Dīn and other associates.
